name: Forgotten Souls
source:
Nadia wakes up in a strange mansion with no memories and only a handsome stranger for help. Can she escape back to her own life, or will the world of dreams claim her soul?

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/forgotten-souls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
纳迪亚在一座陌生的宅邸中醒来，她失去了记忆，只有一个英俊的陌生人寻求帮助。她能否逃回自己的生活，还是梦境世界夺走她的灵魂？

[来自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/forgotten-souls]itch.io[/url]]
